h:
WAN 2.2 工作流程比我意识到的要多得多，但现在为时已晚:)也许有人会发现它有用。

RTX 3060 12GB |锐龙 5 3600 | 32GB 内存 | 45-98gb 页面文件

（模型已加载，5 秒视频）

I2V & T2V：约6分钟

+MMAudio：约8分钟

我将分辨率设置为 480，但您可以使用分辨率大师的预设来更改它。我考虑添加一个升级器，但我没有注意到差异，它增加了额外的一分钟。

下载次数：

---

如果您不想同时下载 I2V 和 T2V 模型，我不推荐此 WF。如果您出于某种原因仍想尝试，请在 WAN 检查点文件夹中添加虚拟文件，并将它们用作未下载的模型以防止错误。

基本模型和 VAE：https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B-GGUF/tree/main&https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-GGUF/tree/main

模型2：https://civitai.red/models/2456413/dasiwa-wan-22-i2v-14b-boundbite-v10-or-lightspeed-or-gguf?modelVersionId=2763939

我用的是Q5。您只需要第一个链接中的一个 VAE。 Model-2 不需要以下 Lightx2v 模型。

CLIP (UMT5)：使用 ComfyUI Manager 下载！

光x2v：https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-StepDistill-CfgDistill-Lightx2v/tree/main/loras

MMAudio：链接位于 v3 的工作流程中。如果您来自 LTX，MMAudio 还可以，但它不能进行语音并且非常基础。

---

对于 I2V，您可以使用 Florence 并将提示留空，除非您想要特定的内容。

要显示视频预览，请在 VHS 设置中启用“采样时显示动画预览”。

如果您想要 FLF 实现完美循环以外的任何效果，请使用不同的图像开关。

NSFW 交换机旨在与 CubeyAI 的 NSFW lora 配合使用。在 v3 中，它仅将 MMAudio 模型从 NSFW 模型切换为常规模型。

如果您不需要，请删除 VAE Decode 附近的所有文件名内容。

o.en:
There are far more WAN 2.2 workflows than I realized, but it's too late now :) Maybe someone will find it useful.

RTX 3060 12gb | Ryzen 5 3600 | 32gb RAM | 45-98gb Page File

(With models loaded, 5 second vid)

I2V & T2V: Around 6 minutes

+MMAudio: Around 8 minutes

I set the res to 480 but you can change it using Resolution Master's presets. I considered adding an upscaler, but I couldn't notice a difference and it added an extra minute.

Downloads:

---

I don't recommend this WF if you don't want to download both the I2V and T2V models. If you want to try it still for some reason, add dummy files in your WAN checkpoint folder and use them as the undownloaded models to prevent an error.

Base models & VAE:https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B-GGUF/tree/main&https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-GGUF/tree/main

Model-2:https://civitai.red/models/2456413/dasiwa-wan-22-i2v-14b-boundbite-v10-or-lightspeed-or-gguf?modelVersionId=2763939

I use Q5. You only need one VAE from either of the first links. Model-2 doesn't need the Lightx2v models below.

CLIP (UMT5): Download with ComfyUI Manager!

Lightx2v:https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-StepDistill-CfgDistill-Lightx2v/tree/main/loras

MMAudio: Links are in v3's workflow. If you're coming from LTX, MMAudio is okay, but it can't do speech and is very basic.

---

For I2V, you can use Florence and leave your prompt empty unless you want something specific.

To show video previews, turn on "Display animated previews when sampling" in VHS' settings.

If you want FLF for anything other than perfect loops, use the different image switch.

The NSFW switch was made to work with CubeyAI's NSFW lora. In v3, it only switches the MMAudio model from the NSFW one to the regular one.

Delete all the filename stuff near VAE Decode if you don't want them.
